meta.name: obsidian-skills-integrated
meta.description: 内容创作者与技术写作员在让AI撰写Obsidian笔记时，使用此官方技能可精准处理双链、Callout及Bases数据库语法，一键生成格式零破坏的Canvas画布与专业笔记，彻底解决AI破坏专属格式的痛点。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI生成格式正确的Obsidian笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI写Obsidian笔记但总担心格式被破坏
copy.tagline_en: Generate Obsidian notes with correct formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write Obsidian notes but worry about broken formatting

howto.what: 在 Obsidian 库内写笔记时,Claude 会按 Obsidian 专属语法处理双链、Callout、Frontmatter,并生成 .md 笔记、.canvas 画布和 .base 数据库文件,不改坏原有格式。
howto.when: 当你在 Obsidian 库内让 AI 撰写或编辑笔记时接管,例如创建带双链和 Callout 的笔记、生成 Canvas 画布或 Bases 数据库等。

say.text: 用 json-canvas 画一张按势力分组上色的关系图
say.note: 产出 .canvas 文件,需在 Obsidian 中打开

say.text: 用 obsidian-bases 建个读书清单,按评分排序,只看已读

howto.what_en: Inside an Obsidian vault, Claude writes notes using Obsidian syntax — wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter — and produces .md notes, .canvas boards and .base databases without breaking the existing format.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask Claude to write or edit notes inside an Obsidian vault, such as notes with wikilinks, Canvas boards, or Bases databases.

say_en.text: Use obsidian-markdown to write a note with wikilinks and an INFO callout
say_en.note: Produces a .md note keeping Obsidian syntax

say_en.text: Use json-canvas to draw a relation graph grouped and colored by faction
say_en.note: Outputs a .canvas file, opened in Obsidian

say_en.text: Use obsidian-bases to build a reading list sorted by rating, read only
